notes.title: V1.6 version update Bulletin
notes.content:
V1.6 version update Bulletin

Update time: 2018/5/24

Update content:

1.	Join the equipment identification function. Now the equipment that the monster drops can be identified at the new NPC in the camp, so that additional random combat attributes can be obtained. Higher quality equipment may gain more combat attributes.

2.	The weapon wind was added. After the enchantment of the melee weapon, player can release the wind to attack the monsters by firing weapons. The sword wind has the property damage, and it is different according to the attributes of enchantment on the weapon.

3.	The recognition area of the transmission reel is adjusted to avoid releasing the transmission gate due to misoperation.

notes.title: V1.5 version update Bulletin
notes.content:
Update time: 2018/4/26

Update content:

1.	Thanks to the players from Germany (from VR Gamer's BeSyres and Delorean 787) to provide us with German translation, including all words and spell speech (All of the spells are recorded by VR Gamer). Now the game supports German! I hope to bring more smooth experience to German players.

2.	Change the name of the magic "Mana Burnning" to "Warmth". (This suggestion comes from player: Marc).

3.	Solves the problem that players sometimes can't archery fast continuously under the condition of networking.

4.	Adjusted the use interval of the teleportation.

5.	The display range of the map is added.

6.	The deviation of the direction of the scattering arrow is corrected.

notes.title: V1.4 version update notice
notes.content:
V1.4 version update notice

Update time: 2018/4/10

Update content:
1.	We joined the PC game function. Now players can play games by using mouse and keyboard instead of forcing the use of VR devices.

2.	Add the "original resurrection" function. When the player dies in the game, the player can choose to resurrect in the camp or resurrect in the place. If you choose to resurrect, the player will lose a certain amount of gold.

3.	Add a new skill "Mana burning". Mana burning effect is: quick recovery of the player's Mana.

4.	The game's initial skill learning point is adjusted. Now players can learn “fireball” at the beginning of game. The original player can learn new skills or get a new skill point at the original place after the game is updated.

5.	Increases the damage effect of most of the magic. Considering that the cost of speech release magic is higher than that of ordinary PC games, it increases the magic effect to enhance the pleasure of combat.

6.	Now, the name of the monster can be displayed at the top of the monster.

7.	According to the feedback from some national players, the game chat voice option is added to the online game. The player can choose to open the game with the voice chat function or use the third party voice chat software to communicate with other players.

8.	Adjust part of the description in the game.

9.	Added the special effect of the spell reciting failure. Now when the spell fails, the energy ball will dissipate ahead.

notes.title: V1.3 version update notice
notes.content:
Update time: 2018/3/2

Update content:
1.	Thanks to Letramorte from Australia to provide new translations for the English instructions in the game. We hoped that his efforts can help players all over the world understand the game better and get a better experience.
We are very grateful to Letramorte!
(in addition, we welcome interested players to participate in our localization work, such as German, Russian and French. If you are interested, welcome to contact me by add my friend or send emails.)

2.	Now, the handover function of the left and right hand is added, hoping to make the left - handed friend have a comfortable experience. (This suggestion comes from player: HOSHI82)

3.	We reproduced the operation for the bow, and hope you can have a better experience.

4.	Add a new hint for delete role operations to avoid the deletion of the role caused by the error.

5.	Optimize the part of the operation guidance.

6.	We found that many players didn't know that the staff can release energy balls by hitting the panel of the right-hand controller after enchanting, so we strengthened the guidance hints in this part.

7.	Add the attack ability of the staff: now, without enchantment, a non - attribute energy ball can be released to attack the enemy by hitting the panel of the right-hand controller.

8.	The player’s name will be displayed at the top of the transmission gate which he opened.

9.	Add hints to the warehouse and pet summons in the camp.

10.	The resistance value of part of NPC was adjusted to make it more reasonable.

notes.title: V1.2 version update notice
notes.content:
Update time: 2018/2/8

Update content:
1. Optimizing the graphic performance of some skills;

2. Correcting the sound effects of the sprint;

3. Add the function of "use the right hand rocker to control turning" for Oculus devices (this suggestion comes from player: SaL7Y);

4. Repair the bug in the map interface that the help information can't display normally.

5. We have rewritten the help of the magic book, hoping to better help players understand the way to release magic.

6. We realized that the magic "black hole" was rather weak in fighting, so it increased its power and hope it will make it better in the fight.

7. Up-raise the quality of equipment that fell after the death of BOSS and elite monsters.

8. Fix the error about the display of onlinegame.

9. Fix the error that sometimes there's deviation about the direction between head display and menu.
